title: TRUNK-6670: Fix OWASP dependency check CI failure on fork PRs without NVD_API_KEY
body:
<!--- Add a pull request title above in this format -->
<!--- real example: 'TRUNK-5111: Replace use of deprecated isVoided' -->
<!--- 'TRUNK-JiraIssueNumber: JiraIssueTitle' -->
## Description of what I changed
PRs don't have access to the NVD_API_KEY secret, so ${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY }} evaluates to an empty string and the CLI crashes with a missing argument error. This makes the CI fail on every fork PR regardless of the change.

This change makes --nvdApiKey conditional on the secret being present, so the check runs without an API key (falling back to rate-limited NVD access) when the secret isn't available..

This makes `--nvdApiKey` conditional on the secret being present, so the scan falls back to rate-limited NVD access when the key is unavailable instead of failing entirely.
